[Problem]{.card-kicker} **is the tree a star?** [AC abc225_b · Star or Not](https://atcoder.jp/contests/abc225/tasks/abc225_b)

In a tree there are no parallel edges, so "adjacent to everyone else" is degree $N - 1$. That vertex touches every edge, and every other vertex is a leaf. The centre is one of the two ends of the first edge, which is a way to avoid storing every degree, but the degree array is $O(n)$ and obvious.

[Solved in full in @sec-tr-p5-star.]{.card-link}

:::
